text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
The way you've been runnin' lately ain't like you at all...
Somethin' happen?

text_block_list.name: Underling Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: Th-That's...! Dammit... It's just, in that 'duel' that night... ...had my... taken by――...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...A "challenge"? I can't just let that slide.
Who took what from who?!

text_block_list.name: Lackey Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
I-It's just that I messed up, Boss...!!
I c-could never trouble ya with this, Pocket-san...!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hey!
...Ah damn it, she ran off.

Hmm... So it seems "that rumor"
was true after all?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon, Cafe...
You guys know somethin' about this?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Lately, a horse girl has been appearing on the perimeter course in the dead of night...
She allegedly approaches students of this academy to challenge them to a "match"—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And if you lose that "match",
your "most prized possession" gets confiscated—
Such a truly fascinating rumor, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It's not fascinating at all...
We need to talk with her and deal with this quickly...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: So in other words, some insolent punk is messin' with the academy's turf over bet races...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
We don't need any "talks", Cafe.
I'm gonna blast her away and put an end to this myself.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Pocket-san, are you really going to race her...?
It's dangerous...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Haha, don't sweat it. If I lose in a place like this,
I can't go callin' myself the "strongest"...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Besides, the quickest way to make a speed freak see reason... is through "running", ain't it?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: —Speak of the devil, here she comes.

—Race... with me.
—Bet... your prized possession.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Fine by me. If you win, take whatever
you damn well please. But in return—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
If I win, you give back everything you took
and get the hell off our turf!!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *gasp*...!
You're not bad—but still!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOAAAHH!!
HELL YEAH!! I wiiiiiin!!!

—Why are you... so...
—Strong...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *gasp*... Yeah, well...
Probably 'cause... it's just what I always do...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Betting everything you value... your entire soul on a race—
For me, that's just "business as usual".

—Entire... soul...
—I see... It was because...
—That was the kind of race I wanted...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
My, what a truly marvelous run that was!
To the point where—it looked as though "you were really
racing against someone"!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? What d'you mean "looked as though"?
I was just racin' this—wait, huh? Where'd she go?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
She has returned.
Satisfied with the match, back to where she belongs—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Disap—huh? W-Wait, returned...? No but, we were
runnin' together, and she disap... Wait, you mean...—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
A-A GHOOOST~~!!?
GYAAAAAAH!?!?!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu? So you truly displayed such running
without noticing a single thing, you say—?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Could the mere belief that a competitor exists
truly produce such a "powerful" run?
This calls for continuous experimental data collection—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, next you shall run the course equipped
with this electroencephalograph!
And after that, a psychological test—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oi...
How long is this gonna go on for~~...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, sightings of Jungle Pocket constantly having her data collected around the clock by Agnes Tachyon became a frequent occurrence.
